We've all been there. Meeting up with someone for the first time. Trying not to make a fool of yourself, being critical of everything you do. How do you calm yourself down?

Got your own idea for a discussion? Post a thread! /v/relationships welcomes both relationship advice and general discussion questions.
How do you deal with nervousness and stress during a first date?

I think it's important to realize that both people are probably equally nervous or stressed out. When this happens I'm more likely to say something or do something stupid. I've recently tried to be more aware of what I was saying and doing and try to laugh at myself or point out my awkwardness. I've never had someone walk out on a first date so I guess it doesn't do any harm.

I've personally never felt this way. I'm very at ease socially but I may be able to help by explaining why I feel the that way.

I don't really care or worry about what others think of me. I also never try to make an unrealistically good first impression since it's not sustainable. I just want to live my life being me. If I find someone who likes me and the direction I'm going, maybe it will be fun to go together a while (provided I feel the same about them); but nothing lost if we go it alone either.

I think recognizing that people are just people and that everyone is fallible makes things much easier.

Ya have to remember to relax and be yourself; you don't want to start out as something you aren't and then worry that the person won't like you for you once they realize who you truly are. Plus, if they don't like you for who you are, why would you want to be with them?

I'm a much bigger fan of spending time with someone in a group setting first and seeing how that goes. If it seems like it could lead somewhere, then I'll work toward the one-on-one interactions (and by that time I'm usually a bit more comfy than a traditional first date, which tends to feel like a job interview).

If you're going on a "traditional" first date and feel like you'll be jittery, partake in an activity beforehand that is assured to relax you. Yoga, hiking, video games, whatever helps you find zen. Better yet, see if you can incorporate that activity into the date.
